content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP® Certification in Aurora

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and project-management experience. Review PMI's specific requirements for your background—whether you hold a bachelor's degree, associate degree, or high school diploma—and verify your project-hours total. Granite PM Academy can clarify eligibility before you enroll.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours Online
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP® training. Attend synchronous sessions taught by active certified practitioners, participate in real-world case studies, and complete all contact hours required by PMI. Our flexible scheduling accommodates Aurora's working professionals across aerospace, defense, healthcare, education, and government sectors.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing the course, apply directly to PMI with proof of your 35 contact hours, education credentials, and project experience. Pay the PMI exam fee and allow time for PMI to audit and approve your application before you schedule your test date.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Pass the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-prep resources, practice questions, and study guides to reinforce core domains. Schedule your exam at a Pearson VUE center and sit for the computerized test. Granite PM Academy instructors remain available to answer final questions before you test.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP® Credential
steps_items.text: After passing, you'll hold the PMP® credential for three years. Earn professional development units (PDUs) through training, conferences, volunteering, or on-the-job experience to renew your credential. Plan your PDU strategy early so renewal stays manageable alongside your career in your local job market.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.
